title: Email/Password User Authentication Success
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully using correct email and password credentials and that the session persists.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid registered email and correct password
Submit login form
Check that the user is logged in and redirected to the main dashboard
Verify session persistence on page refresh

title: Email/Password User Authentication Failure
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect email or password and appropriate error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid email or incorrect password
Submit login form
Check that login is not successful
Verify error message indicating wrong credentials is displayed

title: Document Creation and Auto-Save
description: Validate user can create a new document, enter title, use rich text editor with AI assistance, edit content, and auto-save occurs properly.

steps.description: Navigate to dashboard and initiate new document creation
Input document title
Enter rich text content including headings, lists, and code blocks
Invoke AI-assisted writing commands and verify AI suggestions appear
Make edits to document
Verify document auto-saves after changes automatically
Verify saved document is listed in recent documents

title: Document Management: Favorites, Archive, and Search Functionality
description: Verify document can be marked as favorite, archived, and retrieved via search functionality correctly.

steps.description: Mark an existing document as favorite
Verify document appears in favorites list
Archive a document
Verify document appears in archive view and not in active documents
Use document search with title keywords
Verify searched documents matching criteria appear correctly

title: Kanban Task Creation and Management
description: Verify user can create tasks in Kanban board with priority levels, tags, due dates, and AI or user assignment, and manage tasks including drag-and-drop between columns.

steps.description: Navigate to Kanban task board
Create a new task with title, description, priority, tags, and due date
Assign task to user and AI agent
Verify task appears in correct column with correct details
Drag and drop task across columns
Verify task moves and updates status appropriately

title: AI Agent Workflow Execution and History Tracking
description: Validate that users can select an AI agent workflow, configure parameters, execute the workflow with real-time progress monitoring, view output, and track history with retry and cancel options.

steps.description: Navigate to AI agents page
Select a workflow and configure required parameters
Start workflow execution
Verify real-time progress is displayed
Cancel the running workflow
Verify workflow stops and status updates accordingly
Re-run the workflow
Verify output is generated and workflow history logs the execution

title: AI Chat Interface Interaction
description: Verify users can select AI agent modes, send messages, receive context-aware AI responses, and interact with copy and retry functionalities.

steps.description: Navigate to AI chat interface
Select a specific AI agent mode
Send message containing query or command
Verify AI response is relevant, context-aware, and loads with typing indicator
Verify messages appear in history
Use copy functionality on AI response
Confirm response is copied to clipboard
Use retry option on AI response
Verify AI response refreshes with updated answer

title: User Settings Profile Update and AI Model Configuration
description: Verify user can update profile information, configure AI models, manage API keys encryptedly, and change notification and appearance settings.

steps.description: Navigate to settings page
Update profile information such as name and avatar
Verify profile changes are saved and reflected
Configure AI model preferences
Verify AI model settings persist and take effect
Add, update, and remove API keys
Verify API keys are stored encrypted and UI masks key values
Modify notification preferences and themes
Verify notification and appearance settings apply correctly

title: Real-Time Collaboration and Sync Latency
description: Verify multiple users can edit documents and tasks collaboratively with minimal sync latency below 200ms and data consistency across clients.

steps.description: User A starts editing a document or task
User B views the same document or task
User A makes changes to document or task
Verify changes are reflected in User B view within 200ms
Verify no data conflicts or loss occur

title: Performance Verification under Load
description: Validate page load times are under 2.5 seconds and animations maintain 60fps under typical user load on dashboard and editor pages.

steps.description: Navigate to main dashboard
Verify page fully loads within 2.5 seconds
Interact with animations including smooth scroll and transitions
Validate animations run at 60fps without noticeable lag
Open document editor with rich content
Confirm editor load time is under 2.5 seconds

title: Accessibility Compliance and Keyboard Navigation
description: Ensure the application meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards with proper keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility across main features including documents, tasks, and chat.

steps.description: Navigate through application using keyboard only
Verify all interactive elements are reachable and usable via keyboard
Use screen reader to read out UI elements and content
Verify all relevant content and controls have meaningful labels and roles
Check color contrast and scalable font sizes
Confirm compliance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA contrast and scaling guidelines

title: Security: Encrypted API Key Storage and Input Sanitization
description: Verify that API keys are stored encrypted, input fields sanitize user inputs preventing injection, and security protocols including HTTPS enforcement, secure cookies, CSRF protection, and rate limiting are effective.

steps.description: Add an API key in user settings
Verify API key is stored encrypted and not exposed in plaintext anywhere
Try entering malicious code or scripts into input fields
Confirm inputs sanitize or reject unsafe content preventing injection attacks
Access application over HTTP
Verify application redirects to HTTPS
Verify HTTP cookie flags are set to secure and HttpOnly
Attempt CSRF attack patterns
Confirm CSRF protection mechanisms block attacks
Perform rapid API requests to test rate limiting
Verify rate limiting activates and returns appropriate throttling responses

title: Global Command Palette Navigation and Action Execution
description: Verify that the command palette opens via shortcut and allows quick navigation and action execution such as opening documents, switching sections, and creating tasks.

steps.description: Press global command palette keyboard shortcut
Verify command palette opens with input focus
Type command keywords to search for documents, tasks, and other actions
Verify relevant command/action suggestions appear
Select a command to open a document or navigate to a page
Confirm navigation or action executes successfully
